@@ -0,0 +1,65 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+depends_on:
+- 01M1MNYFW81216M57PS9NDZKBE
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: 8b80
+title: config init and config edit, sharing one writer with /config export
+---
+## What
+
+cli-plan.md §5.11. `config show` reads. These two write.
+
+**`config init`** writes a `config.yaml` with every key at its default,
+each under a comment that says what the key does. The generator reads
+`AgentConfiguration.CodingKeys` and each section's `CodingKeys`, so a new
+key cannot be forgotten.
+
+- `--user` writes the user layer, `--project` the project layer.
+  `--project` is the default.
+- It refuses to overwrite an existing file, and it exits 1 with a
+  message that names `--force`.
+- `--force` overwrites.
+- It prints the path it wrote, to stdout.
+
+**`config edit`** opens the nearest `config.yaml` in `$EDITOR`. With no
+file in any layer, it runs the `config init` path first and says so on
+stderr. With no `$EDITOR`, it exits 1 and says which variable to set.
+
+**One implementation.** The `/config export` slash command
+(`plan.md` §14.1) already writes this file. Extract the generator into
+`Sources/FoundationModelsACPAgent/Configuration/ConfigurationWriter.swift`,
+and call it from both. Two front doors, one behavior.
+
+- [ ] `ConfigurationWriter`, generated from the coding keys
+- [ ] `config init`, with `--user`, `--project` and `--force`
+- [ ] `config edit`, with the missing-file and missing-`$EDITOR` paths
+- [ ] `/config export` calls the same writer
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+
+- [ ] `config init` writes a file that `ConfigurationLoader` reads back
+      to exactly `AgentConfiguration()`.
+- [ ] Every top-level section and every key of the schema appears in the
+      generated file.
+- [ ] A second `config init` without `--force` exits 1 and changes no
+      file.
+- [ ] `config edit` with no `$EDITOR` exits 1 and names the variable.
+- [ ] `/config export` and `config init` produce byte-identical files.
+
+## Tests
+
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsACPAgentTests/ConfigInitTests.swift`: write
+      into a temporary stack, load it back, and assert equality with
+      `AgentConfiguration()`.
+- [ ] A test walks `AgentConfiguration.sectionSchemas` and asserts that
+      each known key appears in the generated text. A new key with no
+      comment fails the test.
+- [ ] The refuse-to-overwrite path, and the `--force` path.
+- [ ] A test asserts that the `/config export` output equals the
+      `config init` output.
+- [ ] `swift test` passes.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file
